purpose: Every pinned-JAR worldgen-confirmed raw non-ore stone gets a seed-block Galore recipe; specialist ore resources and non-stone features excluded.

excluded_natural_candidates.forbidden_arcanus:runic_darkstone: Rune-bearing ore; mining yields Forbidden Rune, not common building stone
excluded_natural_candidates.malum:brilliant_stone: Brilliant ore-forming resource block; verify loot before unlimited generation
excluded_natural_candidates.malum:brilliant_deepslate: Brilliant ore variant, not plain terrain
excluded_natural_candidates.pastel:infested_blackslag: Infested host block; not ordinary stone
excluded_natural_candidates.pastel:rock_crystal: Special rock crystal resource, not common stone
excluded_natural_candidates.astralsorcery:aquamarine_shale: Aquamarine-bearing ore-equivalent; native Chalice fluid consumption retained
excluded_natural_candidates.pastel:slate_noxcap_block: Fungal block named Slate, not mineral stone
excluded_natural_candidates.pastel:stripped_slate_noxcap_stem: Stripped fungal stem, not mineral stone

worldgen_unification.scope: Primal Magick ordinary marble ore-generation feature only; preserved placement and biome mods. Pastel Basal Marble dimension terrain and Goety structures remain unchanged.

material_discovery_gate: Each Galore recipe requires a matching placed block directly below generator: no block until first obtained/placed; uses stationary water/lava adjacent, no fluid consumption.
notes: Worldgen evidence from static pinned JAR JSON is not proof of live spawn; client/terrain tests remain.
Intentional exceptions to the blanket rule are documented in excluded_natural_candidates, primarily ore equivalents, special infested hosts, gemstones, and fungi.
The pack's existing Galore base recipes for stone/cobble/andesite/diorite/granite/tuff/basalt/obsidian/netherrack are NOT replaced.

Marble stonecutter conversions are 1:1 bidirectional between Astral and Primal Magick's identically named ordinary overworld marble. Pastel Basal Marble remains dimension-specific; Goety Marble keeps its totem/Cursed Infuser progression and dedicated structures.
No ore items or drops become Galore outputs, and named natural stone's first-acquisition requirement is preserved by the seed modifier.
Natural dimension-dominant stones stay as their native worldgen blocks; only the truly duplicate ordinary overworld marble gets one canonical material.
Exact published Galore 0.2.9 JAR already implements blackstone, calcite and end_stone: preserve native recipes, do not add duplicates.
